commits.subject: Merge frozen main while preserving Lambda resource ID behavior

report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.

metadata.body:
<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Aligns AWS Lambda `cloud.resource_id` with the [FaaS semantic conventions](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/resource/faas/#faas-resource-attributes), which require replacing an invoked ARN's alias suffix with the resolved function version.

```text
arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789:function:test:prod
-> arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789:function:test:42
```

Numeric version qualifiers and unqualified ARNs remain unchanged. When function version information is unavailable, the invoked ARN is preserved.

cc @open-telemetry/lambda-extension-approvers
metadata.title: Resolve AWS Lambda alias resource IDs
